articles.title: NCPA Highlights Ongoing PBM Underpayment and Cost-Plus Pressures on Independent Pharmacies
articles.summary: The National Community Pharmacists Association highlighted persistent issues with PBM pharmacy reimbursement, including chronic underpayment and new financial strains introduced by cost-plus pharmacy models. These ongoing reimbursement friction points impact pharmacy networks and supply chain stability, which ultimately influence the cost and access dynamics managed by self-funded employers.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Topics; Sun, 18 Oct 2026 15:25:47 GMT

articles.title: Employer Health Care Costs Projected to Rise Over 8% in 2027
articles.summary: Projections indicate that employer-sponsored health care costs will increase by more than 8% next year, driven largely by specialty drug spend and utilization trends. This upward cost trajectory puts mounting pressure on self-funded employers to reevaluate their pharmacy benefit strategies and cost-containment measures. The trend underscores the critical need for proactive plan management to protect self-funded plan sponsors from escalating healthcare inflation.
